_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Codelist profile UML. The profile is defined at metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifCodelist/schema.yaml. Attributes mirror that JSON schema exactly — CDIF deliberately uses a small CDIF-curated subset of SKOS / dcterms / schema.org properties, not the full SKOS vocabulary. The Anchors package re-declares CatalogRecord so the diagram can show the required https://w3id.org/cdif/codelist/1.0 conformance constraint as an attribute on the metadata record (schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord > dcterms:conformsTo).

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Codelist Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Controlled vocabulary codelists expressed as SKOS Concept Schemes
targetModel.definition: CDIF profile for controlled-vocabulary codelists implemented as SKOS ConceptSchemes. Required attributes per the profile JSON schema: ConceptScheme has @id, schema:identifier, schema:dateModified, skos:prefLabel, skos:hasTopConcept, plus (schema:license OR schema:conditionsOfAccess); CdifCodelistConcept has @id, skos:inScheme, skos:prefLabel, skos:notation. A concept that has skos:narrower children must also declare skos:broader. The catalog record (schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord) MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/codelist/1.0.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Profile for controlled-vocabulary codelists as SKOS ConceptSchemes.

package.name: Classes
package.definition: Classes of the CDIF Codelist profile: ConceptScheme (the codelist) and Concept (the codes).

package.name: Support
package.definition: Supporting structured types: Identifier (the schema:PropertyValue form of schema:identifier), Reference (a stub for cdif:Reference; full definition in CDIFCore).

package.name: Anchors
package.definition: Stub re-declarations of CDIFCore classes that this profile attaches to. Provided so the diagram can render attachment edges without dragging in the full CDIFCore class graph.

class._comment: skos:ConceptScheme - the codelist. CDIF intentionally uses a small subset of SKOS+dcterms+schema.org properties (not the full SKOS vocabulary). Required: @id (identifier), schema:identifier, schema:dateModified, skos:prefLabel, skos:hasTopConcept, plus (license OR conditionsOfAccess). v1.1 sourceClass=ConceptSystem preserves the DDI-CDI provenance link.
class.definition: A SKOS Concept Scheme - an aggregation of one or more SKOS Concepts forming a controlled vocabulary or codelist. The metadata record describing this scheme (schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord) MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/codelist/1.0.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the concept scheme. Required.

attribute.name: prefLabel
attribute.definition: skos:prefLabel - the preferred lexical label for the concept scheme. Required.

attribute.name: definition
attribute.definition: skos:definition - formal explanation of the meaning or purpose of this concept scheme.

attribute.name: note
attribute.definition: skos:note - general note about the concept scheme.

attribute.name: dateModified
attribute.definition: schema:dateModified - ISO 8601 date when the codelist was last modified. Required.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - web location of a page describing the codelist.

attribute.name: license
attribute.definition: schema:license - license for the codelist. Either schema:license OR schema:conditionsOfAccess is required (anyOf).

attribute.name: conditionsOfAccess
attribute.definition: schema:conditionsOfAccess - text statement of access conditions. Either schema:license OR schema:conditionsOfAccess is required (anyOf).

class._comment: skos:Concept (CdifCodelistConcept) - a single code in a codelist. Required: @id, skos:inScheme, skos:prefLabel, skos:notation. skos:broader is required on any concept that appears as a skos:narrower child of another concept (CDIF requires both directions explicit for hierarchy traversal).
class.definition: A SKOS Concept constrained for CDIF codelist use. Must have a resolvable @id, skos:inScheme (back-pointer to its ConceptScheme), skos:prefLabel, and skos:notation. Hierarchical concepts must declare both skos:narrower (downward) and skos:broader (upward).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - globally unique, resolvable URI for this concept. Required.

attribute.name: prefLabel
attribute.definition: skos:prefLabel - preferred lexical label for this concept. Required.

attribute.name: notation
attribute.definition: skos:notation - classification code for this concept within the scheme. Required.

attribute.name: definition
attribute.definition: skos:definition - formal definition of this concept. Optional in CDIF.

class._comment: Identifier (schema:PropertyValue form of schema:identifier). CDIF allows schema:identifier to be either a plain string URI or a structured PropertyValue object with propertyID/value/url. isDataType:true because the PropertyValue has no independent identity.
class.definition: schema:PropertyValue form of schema:identifier. Used when the codelist needs a structured identifier (propertyID + value + url) instead of a plain URI string.

attribute.name: propertyId
attribute.definition: schema:propertyID - URI of the identifier scheme (e.g. doi:, orcid:).

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: schema:value - the identifier value within that scheme.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - resolvable URL form of the identifier.

class._comment: CatalogRecord stub - the metadata-about-this-resource node sitting under schema:subjectOf. The diagram needs to show that dcterms:conformsTo must include https://w3id.org/cdif/codelist/1.0 for the codelist profile to apply. Full definition is in CDIFCore.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::CatalogRecord (the metadata-about-the-metadata node carried at schema:subjectOf on a ConceptScheme). For the codelist profile, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/codelist/1.0.

attribute.name: conformsTo
attribute.definition: dcterms:conformsTo - URIs of specifications this metadata record conforms to. MUST include the constant https://w3id.org/cdif/codelist/1.0 for the codelist profile.

class._comment: Reference (cdif:Reference) stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'Reference' resolve inside this profile; the canonical definition lives in the CDIFCore profile and the cdifDataType/cdifReference building block.
class.definition: cdif:Reference (stub). A typed reference to an external entity. Full definition in CDIFCore::Reference and cdifDataType/cdifReference.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI of the referenced resource.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - human-readable label for the URI.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - short summary of the referenced resource.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - resolvable URL (when distinct from the @id).

association._comment: ConceptScheme -> CatalogRecord via schema:subjectOf. This is the attachment point for the cdif:codelist/1.0 conformance declaration.
association.definition: schema:subjectOf - the catalog record describing this codelist's metadata. For a CDIF codelist, the CatalogRecord MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/codelist/1.0.

association._comment: ConceptScheme -> Identifier via schema:identifier (structured form). Composition: the PropertyValue has no independent identity. schema:identifier may alternatively be a plain string URI (the JSON schema admits both); the structured form is what this UML edge captures.
association.definition: schema:identifier - the structured (PropertyValue) form of the codelist's primary identifier. Required (either as string URI or as Identifier).

association._comment: ConceptScheme -> Concept via skos:hasTopConcept. Composition with minOccurs=1: every CDIF ConceptScheme must declare at least one top concept.
association.definition: skos:hasTopConcept - top-level concepts with no skos:broader in this scheme. Required; the array must be non-empty.

association._comment: Concept -> ConceptScheme via skos:inScheme. Required: every CdifCodelistConcept must back-point to its containing scheme.
association.definition: skos:inScheme - the ConceptScheme(s) this concept belongs to. Required for every CDIF codelist concept.

association._comment: Concept -> Concept via skos:broader. Required on any concept that appears as a skos:narrower value of another concept; CDIF requires both directions explicit for hierarchy traversal.
association.definition: skos:broader - parent (broader) concepts in the hierarchy. Required on any concept that appears as a skos:narrower of another.

association._comment: Concept -> Concept via skos:narrower. Inverse of skos:broader; CDIF requires both directions for hierarchy traversal.
association.definition: skos:narrower - child (narrower) concepts in the hierarchy. Each inline child must also declare skos:broader pointing back to this parent.
